title: New Leads
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael receives a parcel of sales leads but initially refuses to distribute them due to staff attitudes, leading to frustration among the sales team. Instead, Michael replaces the leads with clues for a scavenger hunt, prompting various employees to search for the leads through a series of challenges and interactions. Meanwhile, tensions and conflicts arise between salesmen and office staff, culminating in Michael and Dwight searching the city dump for the lost leads. The episode also features moments of kindness and relationship development, notably between Andy and Erin.

Dwight (dives into dumpster, rattling noises then he emerges): It's empty!
